messages:
maria-infra: Heads up — seeing a bunch of customer reports where requests are getting 429s even though the usage dashboard shows available burst credits. Looks like enforcement is ahead of the metering pipeline.

jake-platform: ugh. is this the lag between ingestion -> aggregator -> materialized view? any trace ids?

maria-infra: Example from acct `org_42`: dashboard shows 500 burst tokens remaining, enforcement logs show `limit_exceeded` at 2026-03-17T12:03:21Z. Metering consumer processed that org's batch at 12:04:05Z. so enforcer used stale state.

olivia-sre: Can we confirm which component is the source: is the enforcer reading the fast-path KV cache or the eventual ledger?

kevin-analytics: Enforcer reads the `account_quota_v1` cache updated by the metering-writes topic. If the write is delayed (we saw a backlog on kafka-partition-7 earlier), the cache doesn't get refreshed until replay.

maria-infra: I pulled logs:
```
enforcer: GET account_quota_v1/org_42 -> ttl=120s, last_updated=2026-03-17T11:58:02Z
metering-aggregator: PRODUCE metering.write org_42 @ 2026-03-17T12:04:05Z offset=1839092
```
So enforcer used a 5+ minute-old snapshot.

jake-platform: That matches the kafka lag alert we had earlier. partition lag spiked ~40k, but enforcer doesn't wait for lag to clear. It just reads cache and enforces immediately.

enforcer-bot: reminder: enforcer configured for strict-burst mode in prod for tier=standard.

olivia-sre: Two obvious mitigations: (A) have enforcer check `last_metering_ts` and apply a short grace window if metering is stale, or (B) fallback to shadow-enforce (don't return 429) while pipeline is recovering.

kevin-analytics: +1 on checking `last_metering_ts`. We already write `last_write_ts` along with quotas. Short-term patch: if now - last_write_ts > 60s then allow up to `grace_tokens=50` for burst requests and emit metric `enforcer.stale_grace_applied`.

maria-infra: Sounds feasible. Also propose adding a console metric and an alert `enforcer:stale-cache-rate > 1%` so SRE sees it before customers.

jake-platform: For a medium-term fix, we should route enforcement reads through the same replay-consistent path as billing: i.e., read through the local aggregator WAL or use the kafka consumer group head offset as a watermark rather than the cache TTL. But that's more work.

olivia-sre: Agreed. Short-term plan:
- Patch enforcer to apply grace when `last_write_ts` is old (PR in platform repo) — owner @jake-platform
- Emit metric + console dashboard panel `enforcer.lag_ms`, `enforcer.grace_applied_count` — owner @kevin-analytics
- Run one-time reconciliation for affected orgs (replay offsets for a 10m window) — owner @maria-infra
- Set incident-level alert if >100 accounts hit stale-grace in 5m — owner @olivia-sre

jake-platform: I'll open the PR now. Quick patch: add logic before throttle decision:
```
if (now - quota.last_write_ts > 60_000) {
  if (quota.burst_tokens < GRACE_LIMIT) allow_with_grace();
  emitMetric("enforcer.stale_grace_applied");
}
```
Will add feature flag `enforcer.apply_stale_grace`.

kevin-analytics: I'll wire up the dashboard panel and a prometheus alert. Can we put the alert in the prod alerting group but with a long cooldown so it doesn't noisily fire on transient backlog?

olivia-sre: Yes set cooldown=10m and page on sustained >100 accounts / 5m. For now, don't auto-escalate on a single account.

maria-infra: Also noticed quota reconciliation job is failing for some partitions due to schema drift — let's run a targeted backfill for org_42 and a couple others that hit 429s. I'll coordinate with infra to bump consumer parallelism for backfill.

jake-platform: PR 4722 created: `enforcer: apply grace when metering stale (feature-flagged)`. Added unit tests. Rolling to canary in prod now.

enforcer-bot: deploy started: enforcer-service v2.3.7-canary -> canary-3 (nodes: c3,c4).

olivia-sre: I'll monitor canary metrics. If `enforcer.grace_applied_count` increases but `user-visible-errors` decreases, we can roll to full.

kevin-analytics: Dashboard link: https://console.redwood.ai/d/ops/enforcer-lag?org=platform (panel deployed).

maria-infra: Backfill job queued — estimated runtime 8 minutes.

jake-platform: Canary healthy for 4m, no increase in error budget. Rolling to 30%.

olivia-sre: After roll: we should also add a reconciliation run weekly and a regression test for delayed metering in our CI (simulate kafka lag).

maria-infra: Agreed. Created follow-up ticket INF-1289 for weekly reconciliation + CI regression.

kevin-analytics: FYI, I'm going to export a CSV of affected orgs and seeds for replay: link uploaded to #eng-platform-private.

maria-infra: Thanks team. Let's keep this thread updated if any customers re-open. Good catch on the kafka lag correlation. :thumbsup:

jake-platform: will follow up on PR and hotfix notes.

olivia-sre: closing loop: hotfix rolled, backfill done, metrics look stable. We'll keep the grace flag on for 24h and then evaluate.

srebot: incident closed — postmortem pending (INF-2026-03-17).
